title: Temporary roles
description: A role for a set time: the bot removes it automatically when it expires, and the member gets a DM both times. On Discord: /temprole.
addText: If the member already has this temporary role, the expiry is replaced with the new duration. A role they already have permanently can’t be made temporary.
memberHint: Type their name (at least 2 letters) or their ID.
roleHint: Only a server admin can give roles with dangerous permissions.
durationHint: Pick one or enter minutes (at most 365 days).
sending: The bot is giving the role…
summary: {minutes} minutes ({duration}) — the member is notified in a DM.
emptyText: Roles given with /temprole or from here show up here.
removeText: The bot removes the role right away, and the member is notified in a DM.
dangerousNote: Roles with dangerous (moderation, admin) permissions can only be given temporarily by the server owner or an administrator.

server.notAssignable: The bot can’t give the “{role}” role (it’s above the bot’s role, or it’s an integration role).
server.dangerous: Only a server admin can give roles with dangerous permissions.
server.failed: The action couldn’t be sent to the bot.
server.searchFailed: Member search isn’t available right now — try again, or enter the ID.
